# WCAG 2.2 Site and PDF Scanner 5.0.4

The package description now matches the version it accompanies. The repository provides a browser-ready synthetic sample report and a reproducible sample PDF for inspecting the evidence format. This release supports Python 3.12 through 3.14 and includes the dependency updates recorded in the changelog. Version 5.0.3 remains available for Python 3.10 and 3.11.

The release has six assets: the standalone runtime, wheel, normalized source distribution, SPDX SBOM, SHA-256 checksums, and commit-bound release evidence.

Automated accessibility findings require manual review before making conformance claims. Keep private site and document content out of public reports.
